claims.claim: Asterius of Amasea was Bishop of Amasea in Pontus.
Asterius of Amasea was born in Cappadocia around 350 AD and died around 410 AD.
Asterius of Amasea became bishop between 380 and 390 AD, after having been a lawyer.
Sixteen homilies and panegyrics on the martyrs survive from Asterius of Amasea's works.
Asterius of Amasea was a contemporary of St. Chrysostom.
Asterius of Amasea's teacher was a Scythian (i.e. Goth) who had been sold in his youth to a citizen of Antioch, a schoolmaster.
